- Left alone: the untracked directory `ClaudeFlash/sessions/1f94c1b3-1a0b-47fa-97f3-4a03d5c19308` — it's not tracked by the repo (it's this session's own scratch), so restoring the tree doesn't touch it. Say the word if you want it removed too.

One note: Git reported `LF will be replaced by CRLF` for all three files while restoring. That's just this checkout's `core.autocrlf` setting on Windows, not residue from the bad replace — the file contents are the repository's.
